faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need to sign up before buying a course?
faq.a1: Yes. You need a free account before you can purchase a course and start learning.
faq.q2: Can I take the lessons out of order?
faq.a2: No. Each topic unlocks only after you complete the previous topic and pass its quiz — this ensures deep, systematic learning.
faq.q3: What's the difference between a subscription and buying a single course?
faq.a3: A single course gives access to just that one track. A subscription gives access to every course at once, and is far more cost-effective long-term.
faq.a4: You can pay online via Click or Payme. The course unlocks immediately once payment is confirmed.
faq.q5: Where do I watch the video lessons?
faq.a5: All video lessons play directly on our site through the built-in player.

terms.title: Public offer agreement
terms.s1Body: This document sets out the terms for purchasing the online courses provided by SellerCloudX LLC ("IZDOSH Academy", "We"). By purchasing a course, the user ("Student") agrees to these terms.
terms.s2Body: Once payment is confirmed, the Student gets access to the course materials under the chosen plan (Start/Standard/Pro). With a subscription, access covers every active course for the subscription's duration.
terms.s3Body: Course topics unlock sequentially: moving to the next topic requires finishing the current one and, where applicable, passing its quiz.
terms.s4Body: Payment is made via Click or Payme. When choosing installments, the initial payment must be at least 40% of the total. If the payment schedule is missed, course access may be temporarily suspended per the agreement.
terms.s5Body: Refund terms are set out in a separate "Refund policy" document — see the link below.
terms.s6Body: For any questions, reach us through the "Contact" page.

refund.title: Refund policy
refund.intro: We take full responsibility to our students — that's why our risk guarantee has two layers.
refund.coolingBody: On any plan — if you don't like the course after the first 2 live lessons/topics, we'll refund 100%, no questions asked.
refund.actionTitle: Action-based guarantee for Standard and Pro plans
refund.actionBody: If you complete every lesson and fully submit every assignment but still see no result, we'll refund you in full.
refund.howTitle: How do I request a refund?
refund.howBody: Reach out via the "Contact" page or message the operator/administrator named in your agreement. Refund requests are reviewed within 5 business days.
refund.note: If there are overdue installment payments, the refund amount is calculated according to the agreement's terms.
